title: Pablo Exclusive Blue Raspberry Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Experience the vibrant tang of Pablo Exclusive Blue Raspberry Nicotine Pouches. This bold flavour delivers the sweet, candy-like zest of blue raspberries, offering a lively and refreshing taste that pairs perfectly with the intense nicotine hit. Designed for the modern, experienced user, these pouches pack a 30mg/g punch. The slim, tobacco-free format ensures absolute discretion, fitting neatly under the lip for a smoke-free experience that doesn't hold back on power. A standout choice for those who want a fun, fruity flavour backed by serious strength. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
